ForePath is the brand of IPvX UG (haftungsbeschränkt) in Herford. Since 2016 we have planned, built, and operated technology for businesses that need it to work every day.
the year it all started
From a one-person business to ForePath
ForePath started in June 2016 with a simple idea. IT systems and software development from one hand, delivered by people who also run what they build. That combination has not changed since.

In 2022 the business became a limited company. A year later we co-founded a cloud start-up, and since 2025 we have shipped products of our own. Every one of these steps taught us something, and all of it flows back into the services we offer today.

Our story so far
Ten years, two legal forms, one start-up, and a growing family of products. These are the moments that shaped how we work.
From hands-on to AI native
We did not jump on AI overnight. We grew into it one layer at a time, and kept what made the work good in the first place.

June 2016
Founded as a sole proprietorship
IT systems and software development from the very first day, for clients who wanted one partner for both.
February 2022
Re-formed as IPvX UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
A limited company as the foundation for longer engagements and growth, with the same services and the same people behind them.
May 2023
Co-founded VMMX Cloud GmbH

Together with the hosting provider dataforest GmbH, we founded VMMX to make scalable app hosting on Kubernetes simple for European companies, with one-click deployments from a data centre in Frankfurt.
June 2024
VMMX wins at garage33
VMMX went through the garage33 incubator in Paderborn and came out on top. The program sharpened our product thinking and showed us what young companies need from their infrastructure.
July 2025
OBMS and Kublade released as open source
We published two of our tools under the Apache 2.0 licence. OBMS is an ERP system for digital business models, and Kublade is a templating engine for Kubernetes deployments.
November 2025
Agenstra released
Our first product: a platform to run and ship with coding agents on infrastructure you control, built in the open.
June 2026
Decabill released
OBMS and Kublade grow together into Decabill, our billing platform for services and SaaS, from cloud usage and projects to invoices and DATEV exports.
October 2026
Full focus on ForePath

Today ForePath has our full attention, with AI at the centre, while our VMMX partners return to their own core business. It was a great time. However, we collectively decided not to continue VMMX. In its place, you can look forward to something great from ForePath, built on everything VMMX taught us.
